questionText: Total drawings of partner #35 during the year were Rs. 210,000. The partnership deed specifies interest on drawings @ 12% (notice 'per annum' is NOT mentioned). The amount of interest on drawings charged will be:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: Rs. 25,200 (charged for flat rate without time factor)
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for Interest on Drawings: Without 'per annum' word.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Accounting for Partnership (Interest on Drawings: Without 'per annum' word):
Rs. 25,200 (charged for flat rate without time factor)

Detailed Context:
1. When the word 'per annum' (p.a.) is NOT attached to the interest rate (e.g. interest @ 12% flat), interest is calculated at the flat percentage on the total drawings without considering the time period.
2. Interest = Rs. 210,000 x 12% = Rs. 25,200.
Hence Option D is correct.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.

questionText: Firm XYZ-13 has two partners A and B with capitals of Rs. 640,000 and Rs. 320,000. Partnership deed provides for interest on capital @ 8% p.a. Net profit before interest for the year ended 31st March is Rs. 101,800. The interest on capital credited to A and B will be:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for Interest on Capital: Sufficient Profits.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Accounting for Partnership (Interest on Capital: Sufficient Profits):
Rs. 51,200 and Rs. 25,600 respectively

Detailed Context:
1. Total profit available (Rs. 101,800) exceeds total interest on capital required (Rs. 76,800).
2. Therefore, full interest on capital is credited to partners: Rs. 51,200 and Rs. 25,600 respectively.
Hence Option D is correct.

Therefore, option (D) is the correct answer.
